name: leftpos

name: bottompos

name: scaledegree2

name: eastindiansolfege

name: notename

name: solfege

name: hertz

name: pitchnumber
label: pitch number
help: The Pitch Number block will play a pitch associated by its number, e.g. 0 for C and 7 for G.

name: scaledegree

help: nth Modal Pitch takes the pattern of pitches in semitones for a mode and makes each point a degree of the mode, starting from 1 and regardless of tonal framework (i.e. not always 8 notes in the octave)

name: nthmodalpitch
label: nth modal pitch
help: Nth Modal Pitch takes a number as an input as the nth degree for the given mode. 0 is the first position, 1 is the second, -1 is the note before the first etc. The pitches change according to the mode specified without any need for respellings.

name: steppitch
label: scalar step (+/–)
help: The Scalar Step block (in combination with a Number block) will play the next pitch in a scale, eg if the last note played was sol, Scalar Step 1 will play la.

name: pitch

help: The Pitch block specifies the pitch name and octave of a note that together determine the frequency of the note. Changing the octave number keeps the pitch name but makes the note sound higher or lower.

name: deleteblock

label: load heap from App
help: The Load-heap-from-app block loads the heap from a web page.

name: saveHeapToApp
label: save heap to App
help: The Save-heap-to-app block saves the heap to a web page.

name: saveDict
label: save dictionary
help: The Save-dictionary block saves a dictionary to a file.

name: loadDict
label: load dictionary
help: The Load-dictionary block loads a dictionary from a file.

name: setDictionary
label: set dictionary
help: The Set-dictionary block loads a dictionary.

name: saveHeap
label: save heap
help: The Save-heap block saves the heap to a file.

name: loadHeap
label: load heap
help: The Load-heap block loads the heap from a file.

name: setHeap
label: set heap
help: The Set-heap block loads the heap.

name: rhythm2
label: rhythm
help: The Rhythm block is used to generate rhythm patterns.

name: tuplet4
label: tuplet
help: The Tuplet block is used to generate a group of notes played in a condensed amount of time.

name: stuplet
label: simple tuplet
help: Tuplets are a collection of notes that get scaled to a specific duration. Using tuplets makes it easy to create groups of notes that are not based on a power of 2.

name: mynotevalue
label: note value
help: The Note value block is the value of the duration of the note currently being played.

name: osctime
label: milliseconds
help: The Milliseconds block is similar to a Note block except that it uses time (in MS) to specify the note duration.

name: newswing2
label: swing
help: The Swing block works on pairs of notes (specified by note value), adding some duration (specified by swing value) to the first note and taking the same amount from the second note.

name: skipnotes
label: skip notes
help: The Skip notes block will cause notes to be skipped.

name: multiplybeatfactor
label: multiply note value
help: The Multiply note value block changes the duration of notes by changing their note values.

name: tie
label: tie
help: The Tie block works on pairs of notes, combining them into one note.

name: rhythmicdot2
label: dot
help: The Dot block extends the duration of a note by 50%. Eg a dotted quarter note will play for 3/8 (1/4 + 1/8) of a beat.

name: rest2
label: silence
help: A rest of the specified note value duration can be constructed using a Silence block.

name: newnote
label: note
help: The Note block is a container for one or more Pitch blocks. The Note block specifies the duration (note value) of its contents.

name: getred
label: red
help: The Get red block returns the red component of the pixel under the mouse.

name: getgreen
label: green
help: The Get green block returns the green component of the pixel under the mouse.

name: getblue
label: blue
help: The Get blue block returns the blue component of the pixel under the mouse.

name: getcolorpixel
label: pixel color
help: The Get pixel block returns the color of the pixel under the mouse.

name: toascii
label: to ASCII
help: The To ASCII block converts numbers to letters.

name: keyboard
label: keyboard
help: The Keyboard block returns computer keyboard input.

name: inputvalue
label: input value
help: The Input-value block stores the input.

name: input
label: input
help: The Input block prompts for keyboard input.

name: time
label: time
help: The Time block returns the number of seconds that the program has been running.

name: loudness
label: loudness
help: The Loudness block returns the volume detected by the microphone.

name: mycursorout
label: cursor out
help: The Cursor out block triggers an event when the cursor is moved off of a mouse.

name: mycursorover
label: cursor over
help: The Cursor over block triggers an event when the cursor is moved over a mouse.

name: mycursorup
label: cursor button up
help: The Cursor button up block triggers an event when the cursor button is released while over a mouse.

name: mycursordown
label: cursor button down
help: The Cursor button down block triggers an event when the cursor button is pressed on a mouse.

name: myclick
label: click
help: The Click block triggers an event if a mouse has been clicked.

name: mousebutton
label: mouse button
help: The Mouse-button block returns True if the mouse button is pressed.

name: mousey
label: cursor y
help: The Cursor Y block returns the vertical position of the mouse.

name: mousex
label: cursor x
help: The Cursor X block returns the horizontal position of the mouse.

name: duosynth
label: duo synth
help: The Duo synth block is a duo-frequency modulator used to define a timbre.

name: amsynth
label: AM synth
help: The AM synth block is an amplitude modulator used to define a timbre.

name: fmsynth
label: FM synth
help: The FM synth block is a frequency modulator used to define a timbre.

name: partial
label: partial
help: The Partial block is used to specify a weight for a specific partial harmonic.

name: harmonic
label: weighted partials
help: The Weighted partials block is used to specify the partials associated with a timbre.

name: harmonic2
label: harmonic
help: The Harmonic block will add harmonics to the contained notes.

name: dis
label: distortion
help: The Distortion block adds distortion to the pitch.

name: tremolo
label: tremolo
help: The Tremolo block adds a wavering effect. Tremolo makes the sound pulse louder and quieter. The rate (first argument) controls how fast the sound pulses (cycles per second). The depth (second argument) controls the strength of the pulsing effect (0-100%).

name: phaser
label: phaser
help: The Phaser block adds a sweeping sound.

name: chorus
label: chorus
help: The Chorus block adds a chorus effect. The rate (first argument) controls the speed of the chorus modulation (cycles per second). The delay (second argument) sets the time delay between chorus voices (milliseconds). The depth (third argument) controls the amount of chorus effect (0-100%).

name: vibrato
label: vibrato
help: The Vibrato block adds a rapid, slight variation in pitch. The intensity (first argument) controls how much the pitch varies (semitones). The rate (second argument) controls the speed of the pitch variation (cycles per second).

name: audiofile
help: Upload a sound file to connect with the sample block.

name: customsample
label: sample
help: Import a sound file to use as an instrument and set its pitch center.

name: setdefaultinstrument
label: set default instrument
help: The set default instrument block changes the default instrument from electronic synth to the instrument of your choice.

name: voicename
label: set instrument
help: The Set instrument block selects a voice for the synthesizer, eg guitar piano violin or cello.

name: settimbre
label: set instrument
help: The Set instrument block selects a voice for the synthesizer, eg guitar piano violin or cello.

name: notevolumefactor
label: master volume
help: The Master volume block returns the master volume.

name: synthvolumefactor
label: synth volume
help: The Synth volume block returns the current volume of the current synthesizer.

name: setsynthvolume
label: set synth volume
help: The Set synth volume block will change the volume of a particular synth, eg guitar violin snare drum etc. The default volume is 50. The range is 0 for silence to 100 for full volume.

name: setpanning
label: set panning
help: The Set Panning block sets the panning for all synthesizers.

name: setnotevolume
label: set master volume
help: The Set master volume block sets the volume for all synthesizers.

name: articulation
label: set relative volume
help: The Set relative volume block changes the volume of the contained notes.

name: decrescendo
label: decrescendo
help: The Decrescendo block will decrease the volume of the contained notes by a specified amount for every note played. For example if you have 7 notes in sequence contained in a Decrescendo block with a value of 5 the final note will be at 35% less than the starting volume.

name: crescendo
label: crescendo
help: The Crescendo block will increase the volume of the contained notes by a specified amount for every note played. For example if you have 7 notes in sequence contained in a Crescendo block with a value of 5 the final note will be at 35% more than the starting volume.

name: aidebugger
label: debugger
help: Debug your music blocks project with new possibilities and more understanding.

name: reflection
label: reflection
help: The Reflection block opens a space for you to think about your learning.

name: aimusic
label: AI Music
help: Upload a sample and adjust its pitch center.

name: legobricks
label: LEGO Bricks
help: The LEGO Bricks block opens a widget for designing virtual LEGO creations.

name: temperament
label: temperament
help: The Temperament tool is used to define custom tuning.

name: modewidget
label: custom mode
help: The Custom mode block opens a tool to explore musical mode (the spacing of the notes in a scale).

name: meterwidget
label: meter
help: The Meter block opens a tool to select strong beats for the meter.

name: tempo
label: tempo
help: The Tempo block opens a metronome to visualize the beat.

name: sampler
label: sampler
help: Upload a sample and adjust its pitch center.

name: oscilloscope
label: oscilloscope
help: The oscilloscope block opens a tool to visualize waveforms.

name: pitchdrummatrix
label: pitch drum
help: The Pitch drum matrix is used to map pitches to drum sounds.

name: arpeggiomatrix
label: arpeggio
help: The Arpeggio Widget is used to compose chord sequences.

name: pitchstaircase
label: pitch staircase
help: The Pitch staircase tool to is used to generate pitches from a given ratio.

name: pitchslider
label: pitch slider
help: The Pitch slider tool to is used to generate pitches at selected frequencies.

name: musickeyboard
label: music keyboard
help: The Music keyboard block opens a piano keyboard that can be used to create notes.

name: rhythmruler2
label: rhythm maker
help: The Rhythm Maker block opens a tool to create drum machines.

name: matrix
label: phrase maker
help: The Phrase Maker block opens a tool to create musical phrases.

name: status
label: status
help: The Status block opens a tool for inspecting the status of Music Blocks as it is running.
